title: I Fixed AI Slop Code | An Agent Swarm That Automatically Creates Human Readable Code
author: YuukiCrypto
selftext:
A lot of my qualms with AI is that I cannot hop into the code and make fixes like I need to. So I fixed that.

  
If you don't know how to code or work at a company that loves AI written code, then this repository will be helpful to you.

  
Meet [Repolish](https://github.com/brandonhenry/repolish). An agent swarm designed to turn a repository into code people can comfortably read and maintain. 



It is very simple. Install the agent skill and ask it to set a scheduled task to run every month. 

  
Run it once and let it work. Your code will clean itself and you can focus on writing your game or software. I'm interested to here if you've done something similar or if this skill was helpful for you.
